# LVGL support: work-in-progress handoff

Status: **WIP.** The binding compiles and runs against LVGL 8.3.11 and 9.2.2; `make lvgl-test` passes (13 tests) on both (session 6).
Steps 1-4 (make target, tests + CI, callbacks, build files) are done. Docs and Studio are still to do (see "Next steps").

Goal, design and generator/runtime details: sections "Goal" .. "Docs / Studio" of the previous version of this file: `git show 0b5a304:docs/LVGL_HANDOFF.md` (still valid; its status/progress parts are replaced by this file).

## Constraint: generated files are NOT committed
`modules/lvgl/mcs_lvgl_api.inc` (2 MB for all tags, ~0.5 MB for one) and `lvgl_api.json` (0.7 MB) are far too big for
the `push_files` tool, so they are `.gitignore`d and always generated:
* `python3 tools/lvgl_gen/build_api.py --lvgl <LVGL dir> --out <file>`: tables for exactly that LVGL (what `make mcs-lvgl` does;
  `-DMCS_LVGL_API_INC="<file>"` tells mcs_lvgl.c where it is). Firmware builds can do the same.
* `python3 tools/lvgl_gen/build_api.py --all` (or `make lvgl-api`): every release v8.0.0..v9.6.0 (git clone --depth 1 each tag)
  -> `modules/lvgl/mcs_lvgl_api.inc`, one file that works with any 8.x/9.x. CI should build it and publish it as release artifact.
* Studio IntelliSense data must be generated at Studio build time (`--api-json`), not committed.
* Pushing big files costs many tokens (file content must be printed + sent). Keep new code in NEW small files.

## Set-up checklist (new session)
1. `git clone https://github.com/amir1387aht/MicroCS; git checkout feature/lvgl-support; pip install pycparser`
2. LVGL trees for tests: `git clone --filter=blob:none https://github.com/lvgl/lvgl /data/lv/repo`, then for each tag
   `git -C /data/lv/repo worktree add -f ../<tag> <tag>` (need at least v8.3.11 and v9.2.2).
3. `make -j2 mcs-lvgl LVGL_DIR=/data/lv/v8.3.11` / `v9.2.2` -> `build/mcs_lvgl_v8`, `build/mcs_lvgl_v9` (and `build/mcs_lvgl`, the last one built).
   `make lvgl-test LVGL_DIR=<lvgl>` runs tests/lvgl/*.cs (needs `npx lv_font_conv` for the binary font asset).
4. Smoke: `echo 'var s = lv_obj_create(null); lv_scr_load(s); Console.WriteLine(lv_obj_get_width(s));' > a.cs; build/mcs_lvgl_v8 --lvgl a.cs`

### Memory debug follow-up
* ASan/UBSan + LeakSanitizer host tests used LVGL 8.3.11 and 9.2.2 with the LVGL allocator switched to the C heap. The original file-font test leaked its loaded fonts and the v9 transition-style test leaked style properties: explicit cleanup was added to the tests. Font destroy now disposes the passed wrapper, preventing its direct reuse or double-free; independent aliases are not invalidated.
* Automatic font cleanup was deliberately not added: fonts and script-created styles can be referenced by host-owned objects that survive VM shutdown. Scripts/hosts must remove those references, destroy loaded fonts and reset style properties before closing. Abrupt interruption can still leak fonts and style properties. Persistent host objects retaining script-owned buffers or styles after VM close can dangle; a complete ownership-aware teardown remains open.
* LVGL 9.2.2 `lv_chart.c:847` triggers signed integer overflow with unpopulated line-chart points under UBSan. This is in upstream LVGL and remains unresolved here.
* Added tests t15–t17 (1,000 object/callback/timer cycles with GC and pending async, explicit font destroy/reuse, and 150 array/style cycles) and five Studio/standalone examples. After the fix, C-heap ASan/UBSan/LeakSanitizer passed 16 applicable tests on v8 and 15 on v9; the remaining v9 test aborted on the upstream chart UBSan finding, so its leak result is unknown. Hardware and constrained heap/OOM/VM-reopen stress remain to be tested.

### PR #76 CI compatibility fix
* The all-release table job failed first on LVGL 8.0: message and animation deleted-callback wrappers assumed APIs introduced in 8.3, and callback helpers were unused. Guarded both code and registration.
* Subsequent matrix runs exposed LVGL 9.0/9.1 differences: descriptor removal is only available from 9.1; observer user data is a struct field before 9.2. Added a compatibility accessor and 9.0 screen aliases for both all-release and single-release generation. LVGL 9.6 deprecated subject init functions are retained with scoped warning suppression.
* Verified all-release builds and compatibility smoke tests for 8.0.0, 8.2.0, 8.4.0, 9.0.0, 9.1.0 and 9.6.0, plus single-release 9.0.0. Both 8.3.11 and 9.2.2 LVGL suites pass (16 tests each). CI now exercises the boundary versions and observer callbacks.
